name: Bestial Pounce (Racial, Combat)
body:
You can charge and make an attack with your natural attacks.

Prerequisites: Str 13, Dex 15, base attack bonus +10, skinwalker or lycanthrope.

Benefit: When you make a charge in bestial or hybrid form, you can make a full attack with your natural attack(s) only.
